headline: Recommended Section C of the policy manual for first reading, with several policies on hold.
summary: Alicia Mallon of the Massachusetts Association of School Committees previewed Section C of the policy manual. Several policies were adopted from the association's versions, while CC and CCB were placed on hold.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 17, 2026 meeting, 2-0 with one absent.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CA, Administration Goals.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CB, Superintendent of Schools.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CBD, Superintendent's Contract.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CBI, Evaluation of the Superintendent.
Placed CC, Organization, on hold to make changes and get feedback from School Committee members.
Placed CCB, Chain of Command or Staff Relations, on hold to get feedback from School Committee members.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CE, Administrative Councils, Cabinets, and Committees, with a modification.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CH, Policy Implementation.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CHA/CHC, Development and Dissemination of Procedures.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CHCA, Approval of Handbooks and Directives, with changes, provided counsel reviews it.
Approved adopting the most recent Salem version of Policy 2107 for CHD, Decisions in Absence of School Committee Policy.
Approved keeping Salem's Policy 2110/CL, with modifications to include the strategic plan.
Approved adopting the MASC policy for CM, School District Annual Report.
Removed Salem's policies CLA and CM.
Recommended Section C of the Policy Manual to the School Committee for first reading, with policy implementation on hold until the full manual review is complete, 2-0 with one absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Member Cornell made the motion to approve the minutes of August 17, 2026. Chair Stott seconded. A roll call vote was taken. Member Manning ABSENT Member Cornell voted YES Chair Stott voted YES Motion passed with 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
CA - ADMINISTRATION GOALS Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CB - SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CBD - SUPERINTENDENT'S CONTRACT Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CBI - EVALUATION OF THE SUPERINTENDENT Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CC - ORGANIZATION Members decided to place a hold on this policy in order to make changes and obtain feedback from the School Committee members.
CCB - CHAIN OF COMMAND or STAFF RELATIONS Members decided to place a hold on this policy in order and obtain feedback from the School Committee members.
CE - ADMINISTRATIVE COUNCILS, CABINETS, AND COMMITTEES Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy with a modification.
CH - POLICY IMPLEMENTATION Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CHA/CHC - DEVELOPMENT AND DISSEMINATION OF PROCEDURES Members agreed to adopt MASC’s policy.
CHCA - APPROVAL OF HANDBOOKS AND DIRECTIVES Members agreed to adopt the MASC’s policy with changes provided that counsel reviews it.
CHD - DECISIONS IN ABSENCE OF SCHOOL COMMITTEE POLICY Members agreed to adopt the most recent Salem version of Policy 2107.
Members decided to keep Salem’s Policy 2110/CL with modifications to include the strategic plan and adopt MASC’s policy CM.
Members decided to keep Salem’s Policy 2110/CL with modifications to include the strategic plan and adopt MASC’s policy CM.
Members decided to remove Salem’s policy CLA and CM.

Member Cornell made the motion to to recommend Section C of the Policy Manual and hold implementation of the policies until the completion of the full Policy Manual review for first reading to the School Committee. ... Motion passed with 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
